sourceTrace.traceEvidence: The exact source entity 0x452 has acis_empty=0, version=2, and a 1,059-byte SAB span; the trace enters dwg_convert_SAB_to_SAT1 and reports the SAB header/body records.
sourceTrace.sourceCodeCause: out_dxf.c stores the final short SAT text block at index i, then assigns _obj->num_blocks = i. dxf_3dsolid iterates only to num_blocks, omitting that final block. For the sub-4096-byte result i is zero, so the exact output entity omits all SAT group-1/3 payload.
sourceTrace.evidenceLimit: The trace and source-code path explain the missing peer carrier but do not establish an independently valid SAT carrier or geometry semantics.

implementation.converter: drw_convertSabToSatV1 parses only complete ACIS BinaryFile version-21200 SAB with an explicit terminal record and serializes the observed SAT v1 profile; for torus-surface it maps the first ordered SAB boolean to forward_v/reverse_v and the next four to I/F range markers. Unknown extra torus-surface booleans fail closed. Numeric SAT fields use max_digits10 and classic locale to preserve binary64 values in text.
implementation.writerGate: writeModelerGeometry admits only AC1021 E3DSOLID, modeler version 2, one exact marker-bounded SAB body range with payload bit offset less than 8, retained complete source frame, exact SAB parse/header, and no DataStorage dependency; emits SAT group-1 text only for AC1021/AC1024 targets.
